title: In the castle
steps: Inside at last: the great doors close behind you, and the castle is warm and bright after the cold road. A teacher is waiting for the new pupils.
Welcome to Arvelia, everyone! I am Ilda, your teacher, and I am so glad you are all here.

I see you are carrying a spare wand lent by a friend, {wizard}. Every new pupil borrows a school wand for the year at the wand bank, a counter run by the pupils' parents, on the far side of the library; then you can give {friend}'s wand back.
Thank you, Ilda! I will head to the library right now to find the wand bank.
I have to go to my first class now, but we will meet at the wand bank later. See you soon!
The library: shelves taller than a house, old books, a hush; and the librarian coming to meet you.
Hello, {wizard}. I am Wenna, the librarian. This library is a place of order, and I will see you across it, teaching you a few new things on the way.
